chapter: Band family, war years and wrap-up
title: The band lineup he liked best
summary: He picks the group of about 1936-40.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Now, were there any particular groups over the years, or did you have a favorite? I guess that's what I'm asking. Out of all the bands, you know, personnel and all of that, was there one that you liked more than others, or that did it for you more than others? You were saying that sometimes you'd get used to way this fellow did a tenor solo, or you'd get used to that. Was there any particular collection of instrumentalists that came together and that sort of represented that sound for you more than any others?
Well, I'd have to say with Bill Johnson, he was on alto. But, I don't

remember what year that was. And Dud, what year was that? Matthew Goe, Sammy Lowe, Bob Rance. That's when we, that must have been around '39 or '40, in those years. We kind of got ourselves together, and out styles. And so, this was the group. [Refers to photo]
Then I started adding, put another trombone. That's when we was moving. This was the group.

Right. And then, finally, it started moving very good again after that when Bobby Smith got in and Ace Harris. When they came, things started moving. They stayed close to that same style, but we didn't go too far off away from that.
